line: Crowley's Atu V: the letter Vau, Taurus, and the uniting of microcosm and macrocosm; the text gives no path for the card.

sections.title: What Crowley says the card is
sections.line: The letter Vau, a nail, and the sign Taurus.

quotes.quote: This card is referred to the letter Vau, which means a Nail;
The card is referred to Taurus; therefore the Throne of the Hierophant is surrounded

sections.title: What the card figures, and where it sits on the Tree
sections.line: The text names the card with the Child, and with the uniting of microcosm and macrocosm. It names no ends for its path; the Key Scale gives path 16. The Chariot chapter places the Hierophant on the other side of the Tree, which is not a path.

quotes.quote: But the main reference is to the particular arcanum which is the principal business, the essential, of all magical work; the uniting of the microcosm with the macrocosm.
It is the aeon of Horus, of the Child.
The Hierophant, which, on the other side of the Tree of Life, brings down the fire of Chokmah.
